instruction: A candid full-shot photograph capturing a couple in a tight tango embrace inside a minimalist room with a plain light wall and wooden floor. The man in the gray suit (R1) on the left and the woman in the black dress (R2) on the right are spinning together. Her hair is in a bun with a blue flower accessory. There is pronounced motion blur on their legs and the hem of her flaring black dress, conveying rapid rotation. The soft, natural lighting emphasizes their close connection and the fluid, dramatic movement of the dance.
